emptyState.title: No recordings yet
emptyState.description: Create a recording for a meeting. It belongs to you, one of your teams or the organisation.
emptyState.noAccessDescription: Recordings of your teams and organisation will appear here. Ask an admin for permission to create your own.

createDialog.title: Create New Recording
createDialog.description: Create a recording, choose who it belongs to and add its audio.

form.fileDescription: MP3, M4A, WAV or WebM. It is transcribed with speaker labels.

validation.fileRequired: Choose the audio file of the recording
validation.fileNotAudio: Choose an MP3, M4A, WAV or WebM file

create.error: The recording could not be created. Please try again.
create.validationError: Please check the name and try again.
create.noPermission: You are not allowed to create a recording for this owner.

delete.error: The recording could not be deleted. Please try again.
delete.notFound: The recording no longer exists or you have lost access.
delete.noPermission: You are not allowed to delete this recording.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Name and origin of the recording.
properties.creator: Created by

rename.error: The recording could not be renamed. Please try again.
rename.validationError: Please check the name and try again.
rename.notFound: The recording no longer exists or you have lost access.
rename.noPermission: You are not allowed to rename this recording.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: The minutes of the meeting, generated from the transcript.
summary.summarizing: The summary is being generated. This can take a few minutes.
summary.retryError: The summary could not be restarted. Please try again.
summary.retryNotFound: The recording no longer exists or you have lost access.
summary.retryNotRetryable: The summary is already being generated or is done.
summary.retryNoPermission: You are not allowed to manage this recording.

failure.noModel: The summary could not be generated: no language model is available for it. An admin can choose one in the model settings.
failure.creditBudget: The summary could not be generated: the organization's credits for this month are used up.
failure.creditLimit: The summary could not be generated: the monthly credit limit is reached.
failure.tooLong: The summary could not be generated: the transcript is too long for the summary model.
failure.empty: The summary could not be generated: the recording contains no speech.
failure.unavailable: The summary could not be generated: the model provider is not available.
failure.failed: The summary could not be generated.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.description: What was said, by speaker. Speaker labels come from the transcription and are not names.
transcript.transcribing: The recording is being transcribed. This can take a few minutes.
transcript.noAudio: The audio of this recording has not been uploaded yet.
transcript.uploadHint: The audio of this recording has not been uploaded yet. Upload it to transcribe the recording.
transcript.speaker: Speaker {{number}}

failure.recordingTooLong: The recording is too long to transcribe. Cut it into shorter parts and upload each as a new recording.
failure.unreadable: The audio file could not be read. Delete the recording and upload the file again.
failure.empty: No speech was found in the recording.
failure.tooManyPages: The recording could not be transcribed. Delete it and upload the file again.
failure.timeout: The transcription took too long. Delete the recording and upload the file again.
failure.unavailable: The transcription service is not available. Delete the recording and upload the file again later.
failure.failed: The recording could not be transcribed. Delete it and upload the file again. If the problem persists, contact support.

audio.alreadyUploaded: This recording already has its audio. Create a new recording for another file.
audio.uploadLimitReached: Recording upload limit reached. Try again later.
audio.uploadLimitReachedWithTime: Recording upload limit reached. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
